rationale: The claim strictly characterizes EASA's proposed DS.AI framework within NPA 2025-07(B) rather than asserting final regulatory policy or an industry-wide ban. DS.AI.010(d)(1)–(2) explicitly excludes AI systems directly contributing to fatalities/multiple life-threatening injuries and online learning with failure contributions beyond 'no safety effect', while DS.AI.130(b)(1)(v) and Table 2 classify H1 fatality potential as an unacceptable risk across all likelihood categories at this time. All manuscript and findings uses preserve this scoped interpretation.
evidence_locators: EASA NPA 2025-07 (B), proposed DS.AI.010(d), PDF p. 4
EASA NPA 2025-07 (B), proposed DS.AI.130(b)(1)(v) and Table 2, PDF pp. 17-18
limitations: NPA 2025-07(B) represents proposed specifications under public consultation, not a finalized EASA Decision or adopted certification basis; subsequent regulatory revisions must be monitored prior to formal publication.
